messages:
Ava: Heads up — delayed at the airport, flight diverted. My primary slot starts in ~40m (23:00 UTC). I won't be reliably on phone. Can someone flip primary for the first 30m? If not I need a handoff plan. :airplane:

Jules: I can cover but I'm in a prep meeting until 23:10. Can shadow from 23:15 onward. @Ravi can you take the first 30m then hand to me?

Ravi: I can start primary at 23:00 and hold for ~30m, then pass to Jules. Will update PD. pinging :bell: @incidents-bot to note swap.

incidents-bot: Notice: on-call change requested by Ava. Please confirm swap. Reference runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prim-sec-swap (steps for safe handoff)

Morgan: FYI — we've had a small spike in embeddings token latency in the last 10m (non-customer-facing so far). If you're switching primary, please check embeds pipeline warmup and KV cache. Dash: /observability/embeds-latency

Ava: Checklist for handoff (quick):
1) Grant KMS access temporarily if needed
2) Run kv-cache flush if latency persists
3) Update PagerDuty primary assignment

Runbook snippet for ops commands:
```bash
# grant temporary kms access
ops auth grant --user ravi --role oncall --scope kms
# set primary in pager for short window
pager set-primary --user ravi --until 23:45
```

Jules: Copy. If you see token latency spike, do kv flush: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/ops/cache/flush` — that'll clear prefix/KV caches. Also tag #incidents if it becomes customer-facing.

Ravi: Grant kicked off now. Also starting a short watch: `obs watch embeds-latency --window 5m` and will tail logs: `kubectl logs -l app=embeds -f --since=5m`

incidents-bot: Swap acknowledged. PagerDuty updated: primary=ravi (23:00-23:30 UTC), primary=jules (23:15-...), shadow=morgan. No gaps detected — overlap window 23:15-23:30.

Morgan: I'll shadow and keep an eye on alerts. If we see 5xx or customer impact, escalate to L2 and tag #incidents + @oncall-sre.

Ava: Thanks all. I'm going into limited connectivity; reachable via Slack but slower. Leaving runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff — follow the post-handoff checklist and leave notes in the handoff field in PD.

Jules: All set from my side. @ops please confirm KMS grant success when convenient. :thumbsup:

Ravi: Grant succeeded. Ran KV flush. Observability shows embeds latency down from ~900ms -> ~120ms over the last 3m. Continuing watch.

Morgan: No 5xx or user-facing errors observed. Looks stable. Safe travels @Ava — closing the swap thread, reopening if anything flips. :pray:
